categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for patients after successful treatment and admission, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release A of goal id=6. Evidenced in multiple variants such as V0008.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway following inpatient care, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and evaluated against post-discharge readmission indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release B of goal id=6. Evidenced in narrative variants like V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents a distinct discharge pathway for long-stay or complex admitted patients, measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release C of goal id=6, supported by long-running complex variants such as V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge path for patients with specialized recovery trajectories, evaluated against post-discharge outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release D of goal id=6, evidenced by variant V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge path for specific clinical outcomes under goal id=6.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release E of goal id=6 as declared in the goal model decomposition.
